label: Temp
description: Provides temporary file uploads and resolves temporary file URLs.

upload.description: Uploads one or more files to temporary storage in parallel.

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: A File object or an iterable collection of File objects.

parameters.name: onProgress
parameters.description: Optional callback receiving { name, loaded, total, percent } for length-computable upload progress.

returns.description: A Promise resolving to one string result per input file, in input order. Success values are server response text; failures are prefixed with "error: ".

getAbsoluteUrl.description: Converts a temp:/ reference to a URL using the configured temporary-storage endpoint.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Temporary resource reference beginning with temp:/.
